description: This file implements the core logic for managing a stack of reftable tables, including functions for creating, reloading, updating, compacting, and cleaning a reftable stack. It handles file operations, locking, and the maintenance of the stack state, making it a central component for reftable management in the project.

methods.name: int stack_filename(struct reftable_buf * dest,struct reftable_stack * st,const char * name)
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a stack-related file, combining the reftable directory with the provided filename.

methods.name: int stack_fsync(const struct reftable_write_options * opts,int fd)
methods.description: Performs synchronization of the data to disk based on the provided write options.

methods.name: ssize_t reftable_write_data(int fd,const void * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor reliably, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: ssize_t fd_writer_write(void * arg,const void * data,size_t sz)
methods.description: Method to write data via a file descriptor, used with the writer abstraction.

methods.name: int fd_writer_flush(void * arg)
methods.description: Flush method to synchronize the file descriptor.

methods.name: int fd_read_lines(int fd,char *** namesp)
methods.description: Reads lines from a file descriptor into an array of strings.

methods.name: int read_lines(const char * filename,char *** namesp)
methods.description: Opens a file and reads lines into an array of strings.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator(struct reftable_stack * st,struct reftable_iterator * it)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse references in the stack.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_init_log_iterator(struct reftable_stack * st,struct reftable_iterator * it)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse log records in the stack.

methods.name: struct:reftable_merged_table * reftable_stack_merged_table(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Returns the merged table handle associated with the stack.

methods.name: int has_name(char ** names,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a name exists in a list of names.

methods.name: void reftable_stack_destroy(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Deallocates and cleans up the stack, closing files and freeing resources.

methods.name: struct:reftable_table ** stack_copy_tables(struct reftable_stack * st,size_t cur_len)
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current tables in the stack.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_reload_once(struct reftable_stack * st,const char ** names,int reuse_open)
methods.description: Reloads the stack from disk, optionally reusing open tables.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_reload_maybe_reuse(struct reftable_stack * st,int reuse_open)
methods.description: Attempts to reload the stack if it is out of date, with reuse optimizations.

methods.description: Creates and initializes a new reftable stack given a directory and options.

methods.name: int stack_uptodate(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Checks if the on-disk stack state matches the in-memory state.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_reload(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Reloads the stack if it is out of date.

methods.description: Closes and cleans up a reftable addition object.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_init_addition(struct reftable_addition * add,struct reftable_stack * st,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Initializes an addition operation for the stack, acquiring locks.

methods.description: Deallocates a reftable addition object.

methods.name: int reftable_addition_commit(struct reftable_addition * add)
methods.description: Commits the current addition, writing to disk and updating the stack.

methods.description: Adds a new table into the ongoing addition operation.

methods.description: Executes auto-compaction on the entire stack.

methods.name: int segment_size(struct segment * s)
methods.description: Calculates the size of a segment of tables.

methods.description: Checks if a segment of tables requires compaction based on heuristics.

methods.description: Public function to determine if stack compaction is needed.

methods.description: Automatically performs compaction if heuristics determine it is necessary.

methods.description: Reads a specific ref record from the stack.

methods.description: Reads a specific log record from the stack.

methods.description: Removes a stale or outdated table file if its max update index is below a threshold.

methods.description: Locks the directory, scans for stale table files, and removes them.

methods.name: int reftable_stack_clean(struct reftable_stack * st)
methods.description: Public interface to clean up stale or outdated tables from the stack.
